doctrine: Volunteer workbench nested under city under county under cluster under assistant campaign manager under campaign manager. Every upstream tier inherits all volunteer-template sections and can open every downstream workbench in scope.
inheritanceRules: Volunteer base sections (My Five, field log, people/follow-ups, training) appear on every upstream workbench
City tier adds community workbench, city leadership slots, local events
County tier adds county playbook and all city workbenches in county
ACM tier adds operators command, field operators, all work branches
CM tier adds full Campaign OS and statewide CRM rollups
futureCrm: PPEN participation layer merges field log, My Five, relational contacts, and intake queue into full CRM
